titolo: APT 28
paesi_vittima: Afghanistan, Armenia, Belgium, Canada, China, France, Georgia, Germany, Hungary, Japan, Jordan, Kazakhstan, Mongolia, Pakistan, Poland, Tajikistan, Turkey, Ukraine, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: This threat actor is linked to espionage campaigns, high-profile doxing efforts, and disruptive incidents that compromised targets believed to be of interest to the Russian government.

titolo: Targeting of Russian aerospace and defense conglomerate
descrizione: Hackers targeted the Russian state-owned aerospace and defense conglomerate Rostec with a DDoS attack on its website. The website was taken down briefly before being returned to service. Rostec blamed the incident on Ukrainian “radicals” who are likely part of the IT Army.
UAC-0188 is a Russian threat actor that has been previously observed deploying malware on U.S. and European financial and insurance institutions.

titolo: FlyingYeti
descrizione: FlyingYeti is a threat actor known primarily for targeting Ukrainian military entities but has also targeted Ukrainian citizens with phishing lures that capitalize on anxiety over potential housing loss.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian citizens who were concerned about facing loss of housing in Ukraine
descrizione: Cloudfare’s security team identified a phishing campaign using Cloudflare Workers (a Cloudfare product) and GitHub. FlyingYeti distributed files that ostensibly helped users adapt to the end of a Ukrainian moratorium on evictions and termination of utility services, but which really installed malware on the target system.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian telecommunications operator Kyivstar
descrizione: Kyivstar, a mobile-phone network that serves over twenty-four million people in Ukraine, was hit by a cyberattack that knocked its entire network offline. Solntsepek, a hacktivist group associated with the Russian threat actor Sandworm, claimed responsibility for the attack.

titolo: Targeting of Polish government organizations with Follina vulnerability
descrizione: In 2022, APT 28 distributed malicious files claiming to provide an update on potential nuclear terrorism, which utilized the Follina vulnerability in the Microsoft support tool to break into the victim’s system. Ukraine’s cybersecurity agency reported on a similar campaign in 2022.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian power grid
descrizione: In October 2022, Sandworm deployed a new variant of CaddyWiper on the industrial control systems of a Ukrainian power plant. The attack caused power outages across Ukraine and occurred on the same day as missile strikes on power infrastructure.

titolo: Targeting of French think tanks, government agencies, universities, and businesses
descrizione: The National Cybersecurity Agency of France (ANSSI) said it had found APT 28 had established a presence on various networks in France since at least 2021 and was leveraging that access to steal emails and information about the compromised systems.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian telecommunications providers
descrizione: Russian threat actor Sandworm attacked the networks of at least eleven telecommunications providers in Ukraine, which led to disruptions in service for some customers.

titolo: Targeting of foreign embassies in Kyiv
descrizione: The Dukes were observed sending phishing emails to various foreign embassies in Kyiv, Ukraine, after the start of Ukraine’s counteroffensive in June 2023. The campaign appears aimed at gathering intelligence on foreign sentiment toward Ukraine.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian energy facility
descrizione: APT 28, a Russian threat actor, broke into a Ukrainian energy facility’s networks of after sending spear-phishing emails to workers at the plant.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian armed forces planning operations system with Infamous Chisel
descrizione: Sandworm targeted Ukrainian military officials with a piece of Android malware dubbed Infamous Chisel. The campaign’s goal appeared to be to steal Ukrainian military plans.

titolo: Targeting of diplomatic agencies in Eastern Europe
descrizione: Russian threat actor the Dukes targeted embassies and diplomatic agencies in Eastern Europe with a variety of spear-phishing lures. The attacks used a new variety of malware based on an older piece of malware the Dukes had used previously.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian defense forces with Capibar and Kazuar spyware
descrizione: Turla targeted elements of the Ukrainian military with Kazuar, a backdoor, and Capibar, a piece of malware used to compromise Microsoft Exchange servers.

titolo: Targeting of government agencies across Eastern Europe
paesi_vittima: Czech Republic, Hungary, Slovakia, Ukraine, United Kingdom
descrizione: Mustang Panda targeted government agencies in Czechia, Hungary, Slovakia, Ukraine, and the United Kingdom with PlugX malware delivered through diplomatic-themed lure documents. There is also evidence that the hackers targeted agencies in France and Sweden as well, but whether they were successful in their attempts remains unclear.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government agencies in phishing attack
descrizione: GhostWriter launched phishing attacks against Ukrainian government agencies. The group used malicious documents purporting to be a report from an expert at the National Defense University of Ukraine.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian email servers
descrizione: APT 28, a Russian threat actor, used spear-phishing lures to gain a hold on Ukrainian government and military email servers and then attempted to expand access to the broader email network. The campaign has been active since at least November 2021.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian civil-society groups
descrizione: APT 28 targeted Ukrainian civil-society groups using a combination of phishing techniques and compromised Ubiquiti Wi-Fi routers. The phishing emails impersonated documents from a Ukrainian defense think tank, the Center for Defense Strategies.

titolo: Targeting of the Ukrainian public sector
descrizione: The Russian threat group Sandworm was observed destroying data on Ukrainian state networks using a malicious script, RoarBat. Sandworm gained initial access to the networks by compromising VPN accounts that lacked two-factor authentication.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government bodies
descrizione: Russian group APT 28 aimed a spear-phishing campaign at Ukrainian government organizations, advertising fake Windows Update guides in order to collect intelligence on government activities.

titolo: Targeting of European diplomatic entities
descrizione: Russian threat group the Dukes ran a spear-phishing campaign against diplomatic entities and systems that were transmitting sensitive information about regional politics, aiding Ukrainian citizens fleeing the country, and helping the government of Ukraine.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government websites using two-year-old backdoors
descrizione: Ukraine’s Computer Emergency Response Team said that Russian state hackers, Nodaria, breached multiple government websites using backdoors placed as far back as December 2021. The hackers used the backdoors to modify content on the affected websites, although what content was modified is unclear.

titolo: Nodaria
descrizione: Nodaria is a Russia-linked threat actor. It has been active since March 2021 and is primarily linked to attacks against Ukraine, including the January 2022 WhisperGate wiper attacks. The group likely also targeted organizations in Georgia and Kyrgyzstan.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government authorities
descrizione: Gamaredon, a Russian threat actor group, targeted Ukrainian government authorities. The group used spear-phishing emails to gain initial access and deployed surveillance malware on affected systems.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian national news agency, Ukrinform
descrizione: The Russian threat group Sandworm used a new Golang-based data wiper, SwiftSlicer, to violate the integrity and accessibility of information within the network of Ukrainian news agency Ukrinform.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian organizations with old cybercrime malware
descrizione: A Russian threat actor, Turla, used defunct command and control website domains to reactivate dormant backdoors installed before 2013 by criminal hackers. Turla then downloaded new information-stealing malware on the infected networks to identify whether they would be valuable for espionage.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian local government organization
descrizione: Sandworm targeted Ukrainian local government networks in November 2022 with Caddywiper malware, which wipes most data on a system while preserving domain controllers. Researchers speculate this function allows Sandworm to maintain access inside networks after deploying Caddywiper.

titolo: Targeting of Polish and Ukrainian transportation companies
descrizione: Russian threat actor Sandworm targeted transportation and logistics organizations in Ukraine and Poland with Prestige ransomware starting in October 2022.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian networks via fake telecommunications firms
descrizione: A Russian threat actor masqueraded as a Ukrainian telecommunications firm in order to gain access to other networks in Ukraine, both through spear-phishing and malicious public domains.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government agencies in espionage campaign
descrizione: Gamaredon, a Russian threat actor, was found using newly developed malware to steal information from Ukrainian government agencies. The malware was distributed through a phishing campaign.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government agencies
descrizione: The Computer Emergency Response Team of Ukraine found that Gamaredon had been breaking into Ukrainian government email accounts.

titolo: Targeting of industrial enterprises and public institutions in Central Asia and Eastern Europe
descrizione: Chinese hackers used phishing emails to plant PortDoor malware on the systems of industrial organizations in Afghanistan, Belarus, Russia, and Ukraine. Security researchers detected the hackers exfiltrating data to a server with a Chinese IP address.

titolo: Targeting of the Ukrainian Azov Regiment
descrizione: Turla distributed Android-related malware disguised as an app that contributes to distributed denial of service (DDoS) attacks against Russian websites. However, the application did not conduct DDoS attacks and instead provided Turla access to infected systems.

titolo: Targeting of St. Petersburg Economic Forum
descrizione: The Ukrainian IT Army attacked the systems of the St. Petersburg Economic Forum in advance of Russian leader Vladimir Putin’s speech, delaying it for over an hour.

titolo: Targeting of media stations such as newspapers and radio stations in Ukraine
descrizione: The Computer Emergency Response Team of Ukraine (CERT-UA) warned that Sandworm was exploiting the newly discovered Follina vulnerability in Microsoft Office to attack media organizations in the country.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian organizations in phishing campaign
descrizione: APT 28 sent phishing emails masquerading as the Computer Emergency Response Team of Ukraine (CERT-UA) with the subject line “Cyberattack.” The email included a malware-laced attachment enabling APT 28 to gather and steal data.

titolo: Targeting of Russian and Belarusian websites
descrizione: Ukraine’s IT Army compromised Docker Engine honeypots in an attempt to execute distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks against Russian and Belarusian websites.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian users of Chrome, Edge, and Firefox browsers
descrizione: Russian threat actor APT 28 targeted Ukrainian internet users with a new malware variant. The malware was sent to targets via email attachments titled “ua_report.zip.” When executed, the malware enables hackers to steal and exfiltrate cookies and saved passwords from Chrome, Edge, and Firefox browsers.

titolo: Targeting of government network in Vinnytsia, Ukraine
descrizione: APT 28 conducted phishing campaigns targeting the Ukrainian military and government employees. Strontium succeeded in compromising a government network in Vinnytsia, a city in western Ukraine.

titolo: Targeting of major Ukrainian broadcasting company
descrizione: Russian threat actors targeted a major broadcasting company with the DesertBlade wiper. This incident followed the Russian military’s announcement that it would destroy Ukrainian disinformation targets.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian agricultural firm
descrizione: Sandworm targeted a Ukrainian agricultural firm’s network by placing a file encryptor on its network, leaving it vulnerable to future destruction. Assessments indicate Sandworm intended to disrupt grain production and exports.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian power stations
descrizione: Russian-linked Sandworm hackers targeted high-voltage electrical substations in Ukraine. The attackers used a novel variant of Industroyer malware, dubbed Industroyer2, which interacts with control systems that manage the flow of power. The hackers also deployed multiple strains of wiper malware as part of the attack.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian organizations
descrizione: Russian threat actor Gamaredon targeted Ukrainian organizations in a phishing campaign. The hackers sent malicious emails with lures related to the Russia-Ukraine conflict, including attachments labeled “Information on war criminals of the Russian Federation” and “Necessary_military_assistance.” The emails contained malware that allowed Russian operators to conduct espionage.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian telecommunication company’s internet service
descrizione: Russian hackers targeted Ukrainian telecommunication company Ukrtelecom’s internet service, forcing users offline. Whether the malicious activity was a DDoS attack or a more sophisticated intrusion remains unclear. Service was restored fifteen hours after the initial compromise.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government officials
descrizione: The Chinese threat actor Scarab targeted Ukrainian government officials with lure documents used to load HeaderTip malware onto target systems. The lure documents mimic releases from the National Police of Ukraine.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian state bodies
descrizione: Russian APT InvisiMole, which has ties to Gamaredon, conducted a phishing campaign targeting Ukrainian organizations with the LoadEdge backdoor. The backdoor allowed Gamaredon to install surveillance software and other malware onto infected systems.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian organizations with CaddyWiper
descrizione: Sandworm targeted Ukrainian organizations with CaddyWiper malware, destroying user data hosted on several dozen systems. Evidence suggests Sandworm infiltrated the targets’ networks before installing the wiper.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian state entities
descrizione: The Belarusian threat actor UNC1151 targeted multiple Ukrainian government agencies with a backdoor called MicroBackdoor. The malware was delivered via phishing emails that included a bait image and files containing malicious code. The backdoor and loader were created in January 2022, before Russia’s invasion of Ukraine.

titolo: Targeting of Viasat’s satellite broadband service
descrizione: The Russian military intelligence agency, known as GRU, targeted the internet provider Viasat’s satellite modems with a wiper that caused widespread communication outages throughout Ukraine on February 24, the same day Russian forces invaded the country.  The attack caused a loss in military communications at the start of the war and affected other government services. titolo: Targeting of Moscow Stock Exchange and Sberbank websites
descrizione: Hackers from Ukraine’s IT Army targeted the websites of the Moscow Stock Exchange and Russian lender Sberbank with a DDoS attack. The incident was planned and conducted through posts on Telegram channels and other social media directing thousands of members to attack specified targets.

titolo: Ukrainian IT Army
descrizione: The Ukrainian IT Army is a threat actor comprised of international and Ukrainian volunteer hackers working in collaboration with officials from Ukraine’s defense ministry to target Russian infrastructure and websites. The IT Army is organized through a Telegram channel where new Russian targets are listed for volunteers to attack.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian and Polish military personnel
descrizione: Belarusian threat actor UNC1151 targeted the private email addresses of Ukrainian soldiers in a phishing attack. UNC1151 hacked the email accounts of military personnel and then leveraged the compromised address books to send further malicious emails, many of which were sent to Polish military personnel.

titolo: Targeting of Latvian, Lithuanian, and Ukrainian computer systems
descrizione: Russian threat actors targeted computer systems in Latvia, Lithuania, and Ukraine with a wiper dubbed HermeticWiper. The malware was aimed at Windows devices, corrupting systems’ master boot records, displaying signs of ransomware as a decoy, and destroying stored data. This followed another wiper attack aimed at Ukraine in January.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government websites
descrizione: Hackers for the Russian military intelligence agency, known as GRU, targeted the websites of the Ukrainian parliament, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Council of Ministers, and the Security Service of Ukraine with a DDoS attack that took the sites offline for two hours. A destructive wiper attack impacting hundreds of machines in Ukraine was reported simultaneously.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian, Latvian, and Lithuanian computer systems
descrizione: Russian threat actors targeted computer systems in Ukraine, Latvia, and Lithuania with a HermeticWiper malware attack. The malware was aimed at Windows devices, corrupting systems’ master boot records, displaying signs of ransomware as a decoy, and destroying stored data.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian banks and defense ministry
descrizione: Russia targeted the Ukrainian defense ministry website and multiple banks with a DDoS attack, taking their sites offline and halting ATM service in some cases. Ukraine, the United States, and the United Kingdom attributed the attack to Russia, which denied the accusations.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian organizations and Western government entity
descrizione: Russian threat actor Gamaredon used spear-phishing emails and malware to target Ukrainian emergency response, security, and aid distribution organizations. In addition, Gamaredon presumably targeted a Western government entity in Ukraine.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government websites
descrizione: The Ukrainian government accused Russia of defacing several government websites. Ukraine claimed that the cyberattack was intended as a false flag, as it utilized malware from an external ransomware group in an attempt to obfuscate attribution. The move came as Ukraine and Russia were locked in a state of heightened conflict, with the Ukrainian government […]

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government and information technology (IT) sector systems with WhisperGate malware
descrizione: The Russian Army’s Main Intelligence Directorate (the GRU) used WhisperGate wiper malware on Ukrainian systems on January 13, 2022. The wiper masqueraded as ransomware, offering victims the chance to decrypt their data for a fee, while in reality, the malware wiped the system. The wiper was found on systems throughout Ukraine, including the foreign ministry […]

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian naval exercises
descrizione: Russian hackers were accused of defacing the Ukrainian Navy’s website and uploading fake documents to spread disinformation about the annual Sea Breeze military exercises.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian agencies in Russian spear-phishing campaign
descrizione: Russian hackers targeted Ukrainian officials in a series of spear-phishing attacks to gain access to government servers for espionage purposes.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian elected officials by Russian-sponsored hackers
descrizione: From January 2021 to at least March 2021, Gamaredon, a group associated with Russian intelligence agencies, sent malicious documents to several high-ranking Ukranian officials. The objectives of this spear-phishing campaign are still unclear.

titolo: Targeting of classified government data in Ukraine
descrizione: Unnamed Russian threat actors attempted a large-scale cyber operation to obtain classified government data. However, Ukrainian authorities prevented a breach.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government document management system
descrizione: Russian threat actor Gamaredon targeted users of the Ukrainian government’s document management system, the System of Electronic Interaction of Executive Bodies (SEIEB), with malware-encrypted documents.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian web servers
descrizione: Russian threat actors targeted vulnerable web servers of multiple Ukrainian security and defense organizations with a virus that added them to a botnet used to carry out distributed denial of service attacks.

titolo: Take down of EMOTET botnet
sponsor_stato: Canada, France, Germany, Lithuania, Netherlands, Ukraine, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: An international coalition of law enforcement authorities successfully took down notorious criminal botnet EMOTET by taking control of its command-and-control servers.

titolo: Targeting of entities in India, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Malaysia, Russia, and Ukraine
paesi_vittima: India, Kazakhstan, Malaysia, Russian Federation, Ukraine
descrizione: Chinese hackers distributed SlothfulMedia malware, which modifies files and logs keystrokes. Specific targets have yet to be disclosed.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government organizations
descrizione: Hackers sent spear-phishing emails to the accounts of officials in various Ukrainian government organizations. The emails contained attachments that downloaded malware when opened.

titolo: Targeting of Ukraine with coronavirus phishing emails
descrizione: The Russian hackers Hades (aka APT 28) targeted Ukraine with coronavirus-themed phishing emails. At the same time, viral disinformation about the virus spread in Ukraine, causing riots.

titolo: Intensified attacks against Ukrainian national security targets
descrizione: The Russia-aligned threat actor Gamaredon intensified its efforts to compromise Ukrainian defense and intelligence targets. The attacks include both cyberespionage and attempted sabotage of physical assets.

titolo: Targeting of Burisma
descrizione: The alleged Russian actors hacked Burisma, a Ukrainian gas company whose board Joe Biden’s son sat on. President Trump had previously pressed Ukraine to open an investigation into Biden and Burisma, which led to his impeachment.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government entities
descrizione: Gamaredon, a Russian-speaking APT, targeted Ukrainian government entities from September to November 2019.

titolo: Attempt to compromise Ukraine’s judicial system
descrizione: Ukraine’s security agency thwarted an attack attempting to target the country’s court system.

titolo: Compromise of Ukrainian government
descrizione: A Russian actor tied to Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB) targeted Ukrainian government agencies with a backdoor attacker called Pterodo before and during Russia’s seizure of Ukrainian vessels.

titolo: Targeting of a chemical plant in Ukraine
descrizione: A threat actor used a tool called VPNFilter to target a chemical plant in eastern Ukraine that provides chlorine to water- and sewage-treatment plants in that country. Ukraine’s intelligence service claims to have thwarted the incident.

titolo: Targeting of financial and chemical organizations in Europe
paesi_vittima: France, Germany, Netherlands, Russian Federation, Switzerland, Ukraine
descrizione: A threat actor uses a tool, called Olympics Destroyer, to target financial organizations in Russia and biological and chemical laboratories in Ukraine and other countries in Europe.

titolo: Alleged Russian compromise of networking equipment
descrizione: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security and the UK National Cyber Security Centre issued a joint alert warning of a Russian state-sponsored campaign to compromise networking equipment, such as routers and switches, to support their cyber operations. A few weeks later, the FBI took control of a botnet with over five hundred thousand compromised devices […]

titolo: Bad Rabbit
paesi_vittima: Bulgaria, Japan, Russian Federation, Turkey, Ukraine
descrizione: Using a tool called Bad Rabbit, a threat actor launched a ransomware operation that encrypted data on networks in Bulgaria, Japan, Russia, Turkey, and Ukraine. The operation is believed to have disrupted the Kiev metro system’s payment network and delayed flights at Odessa’s airport. In October 2018, the United Kingdom attributed this incident to Russian […]

titolo: NotPetya
paesi_vittima: Argentina, Denmark, France, Russian Federation, Ukraine, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: Threat actors deploy a tool, called NotPetya, with the purpose of encrypting data on victims’ machines and rendering it unusable. The malware was spread through tax software that companies and individuals require for filing taxes in Ukraine. Australia, Estonia, Denmark, Lithuania, Ukraine, the United Kingdom, and the United States issued statements attributing NotPetya to Russian state-sponsored actors. […]

titolo: Operation BugDrop
paesi_vittima: Austria, Russian Federation, Saudi Arabia, Ukraine
descrizione: This threat actor targets critical infrastructure entities in the oil and gas sector, primarily in Ukraine. The threat actors deploy the BugDrop malware to remotely access the microphones in their targets’ computers to eavesdrop on conversations.

titolo: Compromise of a mobile app used by Ukrainian artillery units
descrizione: A threat actor compromised a mobile app that Ukrainian artillery units used to assist with targeting. The compromise of the app is believed to have allowed the threat actor to monitor the movements of Ukrainian units in order to facilitate military targeting by Russian-backed rebels in eastern Ukraine.

titolo: A compromise causes a power outage in Kiev, Ukraine
descrizione: A threat actor compromised computer networks that control an electricity substation in the north of the Ukrainian capital, Kiev, causing a power outage. To accomplish its task, the threat actor used a tool known as CrashOverride.

titolo: Compromise of Ukrainian banks
descrizione: A threat actor compromised Ukrainian banks.

titolo: Compromise of a power grid in eastern Ukraine
descrizione: In December 2015, a threat actor compromised power distribution companies in western Ukraine, causing a power outage for more than 230,000 residents. Several control centers were targeted by suspected Russian hackers, who were able to siphon operator credentials and gain access to the power grid for the Ivano-Frankivsk region. The power outage lasted as long […]

titolo: Gamaredon
descrizione: A Russian-linked threat group known as Gamaredon uses custom-developed malware in attacks aimed at Ukraine. The group has been active since at least 2013. Also known as Invisimole.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian law enforcement and government officials
descrizione: A threat actor attempted to compromise Ukrainian officials in government and law enforcement for espionage purposes. Ukrainian intelligence claims this was done in support of Russian-backed military activities in eastern Ukraine.

titolo: Attempted compromise of Ukrainian email accounts
descrizione: A threat actor attempted to compromise email accounts in Ukraine for espionage purposes.

titolo: Crouching Yeti
paesi_vittima: China, France, Germany, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Japan, Poland, Russian Federation, Spain, Turkey, Ukraine, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: Also known as Bromine. This threat actor targets companies in the education, energy, construction, information technology, and pharmaceutical sectors for the purposes of espionage. It uses malware tailored to target industrial control systems.
